Paperplane Apps for Desktop and Mobile

Use Paperplane in your browser, or install the web app when your browser offers the Install Web App button. Native desktop and mobile installers are still in development; join this waitlist for their release updates.

How the native apps waitlist works
01
Choose a platform

Select the desktop or mobile platform you want updates about.

02
Enter your email

Provide an address where Paperplane can send app availability updates.

03
Join the waitlist

Submit the form to register interest. No app installer is available to download yet.

Join the Native Apps Waitlist

We will email you when native Paperplane apps are available for your platform.
